assertions.name: even_close_packing_leaves_most_proton_pairs_unrepresented
assertions.note: d=12 captures 14.8148 % of proton pairs at Z=82; the chain captures 2.47 %. Coulomb is 1/r long-range and a contact graph is the wrong object for it, whatever d is

assertions.name: only_the_deltahedral_row_outgrows_its_quoted_degree_bound
assertions.note: 3A-6 exceeds 5A/2 for A>12 -- a triangulated sphere has average degree 6-12/A, so max degree is at least 6 there, and there are only eight convex deltahedra (largest the icosahedron, 12 vertices). GAP-1's 3A-6 is a SMALL-A construction; past A=12 the honest bound is d=12, not d=5

assertions.name: a_contact_kernel_overshoots_light_nuclei_and_undershoots_heavy
assertions.note: 1/r-weighted capture runs 1587.4 % at 4He down to 73.1481 % at 208Pb, crossing 1 near Sn. The defect is a kernel TRUNCATED AT RANGE 1 standing in for 1/r -- it over-weights the first shell and drops everything beyond

assertions.name: so_no_rescaling_of_the_bond_energy_repairs_it
assertions.note: the ratio spans 21.7012x and sits on BOTH sides of 1, so a constant -- or any single monotone eps(Z) -- cannot correct it. The repair is a decay kernel over all pairs, which is a weighted COMPLETE graph: degree Z-1, exactly the case the theorem excludes

assertions.name: no_constant_bond_energy_reproduces_coulomb
assertions.note: required eps spans 36.3783x across the measured chart. A derived letter is a NUMBER; this is a function of the nucleus, so the escape hatch is not a re-tuning -- it is a different form of law

assertions.name: and_the_required_growth_is_exactly_the_predicted_one
assertions.note: eps_req / ((Z-1)/A^(1/3)) has span 1.0 -- constant to working precision, so the requirement is linear in Z-1 and nothing else. That is the theorem's hypothesis failing in exactly the predicted way

assertions.name: the_omitted_term_is_not_small
assertions.note: at 208Pb the SEMF Coulomb term is a large fraction of the total binding, so this is not a correction the law can carry in its error bar

parameters.a_C_provenance: EXTERNAL SEMF reference constant, used to size the requirement only; nothing is fitted to it
